items.t: NVAX Q3 2026 deep dive: Sanofi milestone and cost controls shape outlook
items.sum: Vaccine biotechnology company Novavax (NASDAQ:NVAX) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, but sales fell by 3% year on year to $68.3 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $400 million at the midpoint came in 4.2% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.19 per share was 54.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.t: Novavax (NVAX) Looks Cheap After Sanofi Milestone And Stronger Q3 Results
items.sum: Novavax (NVAX) is back in focus after Q3 2026 results and new detail on its vaccine partnership with Sanofi, including a triggered US$125 million milestone tied to a Phase 3 combination trial. Recent trading shows how quickly sentiment around Novavax can swing. The 1-day share price return of 10.22% and 7-day share price gain of 6.94% come after a 30-day share price return that fell 3.92%.
